themes_from_content: Embodied AI / industrial robotics demos (dual-arm factory loading, block-stacking challenge, mobile pick-and-deliver)
Robot vision: 6D pose estimation, both a deep-learning version (FoundationPose, RealSense D415, Hunyuan CAD) and a traditional CV version (Orbbec Gemini 335, feature matching + depth normals)
Visual servo / arm planning with MoveIt2, ROS2 Humble, Ubuntu 22.04
Simulation and navigation: Isaac Sim + Nav2; layered architecture of arm visual planning plus mobile autonomous navigation
LLM-to-robot control: OpenClaw + GPT frontend, Node.js / ROS2 / C++ bridge, MoveIt2 backend
Learning notes / internship vlog and Udemy-based ROS2 courses (motion planning, obstacle avoidance, Nav2 tutorial)
